result.quote: I found that the accusation involved questions about their own law
result.reason: The Jews are the antecedent of “their,” so “questions about Jewish law” is fully supported. Although the verse also says there was no charge worthy of death or imprisonment, that does not answer the edited question’s specific wording, “what did the accusation ... involve?” The edit changes the original answer scope by narrowing a broader question and two-part answer to only the Jewish-law detail.
